run_parallel_compose_benchmark: run the parallel compose benchmark to time gtn.compose forward and backward passes on batches of linear graphs
run_parallel_forward_score_benchmark: run the parallel forward_score benchmark to time gtn.forward_score forward and backward passes on batches of graphs
run_parallel_indexed_func_benchmark: run the parallel indexed function benchmark to time gtn.parallel_for with compose and forward_score per batch index
run_parallel_benchmarks_with_batch_size: run all parallel benchmarks by executing the script with an optional batch size argument via sys.argv
review_time_compose_function: review the time_compose function which benchmarks gtn.compose and gtn.backward on paired linear graph batches with self-loops
